registration_timing: Registered after inspection of the 20-replicate screening and before generation, fitting, aggregation, or analysis of confirmatory replicates 21 through 120.
purpose: Confirm a small result-informed set of Person-distribution and observation-design effects while preserving FACETS 4.5.0 as the JMLE calibration reference and keeping JMLE, MML, and exact CMLE estimands distinct.

screening_provenance.selection_disclosure: The six primary endpoints and their directions were selected using screening replicates 1 through 20. They are therefore hypotheses for independent confirmation, not preregistered discoveries from the screening data.

data_generating_process.paired_randomness: Within a replicate, all Person distributions share the replicate seed and all distributions/designs share the registered row uniforms; planned-connected data are a deterministic subset of their complete counterpart.

primary_family.multiplicity_method: Holm step-down adjustment over all six one-sided primary hypotheses
primary_family.test: One-sample Student t test of the 100 replicate-level paired contrasts against zero, using the registered direction.
primary_family.confidence_interval: Two-sided 95% Student t interval for the paired mean contrast, reported without multiplicity adjustment as an effect-size interval.
primary_family.missing_data_rule: No imputation, endpoint substitution, or ad hoc refit. An endpoint with fewer than 100 finite registered pairs is inferentially inconclusive.
primary_family.decision_rule: An endpoint is direction-confirmed only when all 100 pairs are finite, the observed mean has the registered sign, and its Holm-adjusted one-sided p value is at most 0.05. Precision qualification is reported separately and is not silently substituted for the hypothesis decision.

endpoints.contrast: right_skew minus normal within planned_connected and replicate
heavy_tail_t3 minus normal within planned_connected and replicate
symmetric_mixture minus normal within planned_connected and replicate
symmetric_mixture minus normal within planned_connected and replicate
symmetric_mixture minus normal within planned_connected and replicate

endpoints.metric: within-run RMSE of TruthError over all six registered threshold elements
endpoints.contrast: planned_connected minus complete within normal and replicate

precision.calculation: Student t(0.975, n-1) times replicate-level contrast SD divided by sqrt(n)
precision.fixed_n_consequence: A missed precision target is reported as such and does not trigger data-dependent extension of this study.

operational_and_validation_gates.application_qualification_rule: The aggregate qualification_pass must be true. If it is false, scientific endpoint summaries may be retained with their missingness/failure denominators, but this study cannot qualify the application as a FACETS-complementary workbench.
operational_and_validation_gates.facets_precision_contract: FACETS 4.5.0 displayed output is rounded. JMLE calibration uses the registered U6 main-estimate pass and U2 Table 8 pass; no primary threshold or fit calculation is reconstructed from two-decimal displayed values. PYTHON_JMLE supplies the unrounded JMLE primary endpoints.
operational_and_validation_gates.identity_contract: Plan, execution script, execution amendment, retained inputs, attempt completion markers, and aggregate artifacts are SHA-256 bound; a completion marker is written last and resume must validate it before skipping.

secondary_and_exploratory_outputs.status: Descriptive or exploratory only; no confirmatory language and no post hoc promotion to the primary family.
include: FACETS/Python JMLE parity and precision diagnostics
fixed-SD MML versions of registered threshold contrasts
all other facet-level, threshold-level, and global recovery contrasts
free-SD recovery outside H1 and H2
CMLE extreme-person rates and failure denominators

prohibited_inferences: No estimator winner or ranking from recovery metrics across different estimands.
No cross-basis likelihood, deviance, AIC, or BIC comparison among JMLE, MML, and exact CMLE.
No pooling of screening replicates 1 through 20 into confirmatory tests.
No unregistered endpoint substitution, direction reversal, subgroup promotion, or multiplicity-family reduction after confirmatory results are inspected.
No claim that failure to reject proves Person-distribution invariance or estimator equivalence.
interpretation_target: Determine which screening signals reproduce on independent simulated data and whether the application can expose distribution/design sensitivity across distinct likelihood estimands while remaining numerically calibrated to FACETS JMLE.
